$comment: Parameters passed to a data-pack generator. A pack whose body declares <sequence name="domain"> accepts domain="…" from the caller, and the engine replaces that sequence with the constant. This was a reference-only feature: the four ports had no notion of it and refused the whole config with TDC015, so the same .tdc file ran in one implementation and failed in four. Nothing here caught it, which is why these cases exist.

cases.name: declared-parameter-is-accepted
cases.description: `domain` is a local <sequence> of common.internet.email, so the caller may set it
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="E"><gen type="template" value="common.internet.email" domain="example.test"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{E}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: undeclared-parameter-is-refused
cases.description: A name the pack does not declare would be silently ignored, which is what makes a typo dangerous
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="E"><gen type="template" value="common.internet.email" nosuch="x"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{E}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-plain-list-pack-takes-no-parameters
cases.description: person.lastName is a list of values — it has no parameters at all, so the attribute does nothing
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="N"><gen type="template" value="person.lastName" domain="x"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{N}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: pinned-parameter-of-the-right-width-is-accepted
cases.description: `prefix` is the pack's own 2-character code, so pinning a 2-character value is fine
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="R"><gen type="template" value="usa.finance.aba_routing" prefix="12"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{R}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: pinned-parameter-too-long-for-the-pack-layout
cases.description: a 5-character prefix used to pass check and then abort the run inside the pack's compute
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="R"><gen type="template" value="usa.finance.aba_routing" prefix="12345"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{R}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: pinned-parameter-too-short-for-the-pack-layout
cases.description: a 3-character tail used to pass check and write a six-digit value that is not a routing number
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="R"><gen type="template" value="usa.finance.aba_routing" tail="678"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{R}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-parameter-with-no-provable-width-stays-silent
cases.description: common.internet.email's domain is a name list of differing lengths, so no width can be proven
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="R"><gen type="template" value="common.internet.email" domain="a.test"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{R}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: pinned-base-is-a-pack-parameter-not-a-timeseries-attribute
cases.description: common.payment.card.pan declares <sequence name="base">, so base= is its parameter — the ownership table has no jurisdiction over a name the engine hands to the pack
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="C"><gen type="template" value="common.payment.card.pan" base="4111111111111"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-name-the-pack-does-not-declare-gets-one-message-not-two
cases.description: points= belongs to type="pattern", but on a template the only true answer is that this pack has no such parameter
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="C"><gen type="template" value="common.payment.card.pan" points="1,2"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: order-on-a-template-is-still-refused
cases.description: order= is read by the ENGINE before the pack runs, so no pack can claim it
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="C"><gen type="template" value="common.payment.card.pan" order="sequential"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>
